headline: No pure tax structure beats buying and holding SPY after CA (or FED) tax with good confidence, and in this engine none can. SPY buy-and-hold already defers 100% of its gain and pays the long-term rate once, so every structure's measured tax-efficiency gap is <= 0: exactly 0.0000 for loss harvesting (33 no-swap-back SPY-core configs, mean -0.000014), and the largest positive gap anywhere is +0.0001. What remains is pre-tax tracking/tilt noise. The best pure structure (9 sector SPDRs, equal weight, rebalanced only through losses; site manual mode, tax-managed, budget 0) scores +0.0023 in CA on the full protocol (full +0.0060, 10-yr beat 0.49, boot_p 0.30), all of it earned in windows starting 2000-2004. Tax management only helps defensively: losses-only rebalancing beat tax-blind rebalancing on 30/30 random menus by +0.45 pp/yr, and the incumbent's rule lifts random-pick rotation from -2.96 to -0.22 pp/yr. The incumbent's actual edge is momentum (+0.86 pp/yr over random picks under the same rule). Harvested losses are worth something only outside the engine: about +0.2 pp/yr (CA, mean over start years) if they offset other gains, or via the $3k ordinary offset on a $100k account; about 0 on $1M.
findings: ENGINE IDENTITY: the engine pools losses, has no $3k offset and taxes everything at the final liquidation, so a strategy's total tax >= t_LT x max(total gain, 0). SPY buy-and-hold attains the bound. Every window's CA excess = mapped (pre-tax excess of the same trades from the ZERO regime, taxed as if perfectly deferred) + gap, with gap <= 0 (an.py::decompose). Across 511 decomposed records, no harvesting or tax-aware structure has a gap > +0.00004. The only larger positive gaps (largest +0.0001 score / +0.0012 full) are tax-blind band rules whose CA and ZERO paths diverge. So the after-tax alpha of tax management alone, holding market-like exposure, is 0.00 pp/yr in the engine.

(a) SPY core + tax-loss harvesting into different-index twins (SPY->IWB->VTI->VV->SCHX->IWV->SCHB and 5 other chains; thresholds 3-20%; daily/weekly/monthly checks; 4 swap-back rules): 102 configs. CA screen scores -0.0036..+0.0015 (mean -0.0004, 34% positive, lowest boot_p 0.127, none passes). Gap -0.000014 without swap-back. The excess is pre-tax tracking of whichever substitute the portfolio ends in; buy-and-hold VTI/VV/VTSMX alone score +0.0014/+0.0014/+0.0013 on screen. Full protocol, CA: 10% daily +0.0002 (full +0.0010, boot_p 0.33); best 15% monthly +0.0015 (boot_p 0.21; harvested twice, then held VTI). FED is identical to +-0.0001.

(d) Swap back to SPY after the 31-day wash window only adds trades. 'loss' rule: gap -0.00001, score -0.0002. 'any' (realizes ST gains): gap -0.00017, score -0.0015. 'lt': gap -0.00056, score -0.0010. Higher thresholds trade less and score slightly better (3%: +0.0003, turnover 0.135; 20%: +0.0013, turnover 0.022), all noise around zero.

HARVESTING QUANTIFIED (OUTSIDE-ENGINE ARITHMETIC; harvest_value.py replays the exact engine trades and re-settles taxes into a side account in SPY). SPY 10% daily harvests net losses of 18% of start capital per window to 2026 (21% over 10-year windows), almost all in windows starting 2000-2009. In the engine they only offset the final liquidation: -0.0007/+0.0005 (mean of 24 starts to 2026 / 17 ten-year windows). If each year's loss offsets other LT gains: +0.0022/+0.0038 (upper bound). Other ST gains: +0.0049/+0.0086. $3k/yr ordinary offset at 44.3%: $100k account +0.0020/+0.0035, $1M account -0.0004/+0.0009. Stepped-up basis/donation: +0.0033/+0.0079. FED: B +0.0009/+0.0025. Sector-level harvesting harvests 23-27% and is worth about +0.45 pp/yr in the outside-gains scenario.

(b) Sector direct indexing (11 SPDR sectors at an NNLS SPY replica or equal weight, harvesting into iShares IY* / Vanguard V* twins): 33 configs, CA screen -0.0004..+0.0022, none passes. Gap 0 for drift and losses-only. The replica tracks SPY with ~4.4%/yr TE and lags after 2018 (no XLC in the drift portfolio; capped sector funds). Full: best 5% weekly harvest +0.0019 score but full -0.0022, boot_p 0.67. Yearly re-fit within a 1% budget + 10% harvest: FED boot_p 0.090 but 15-yr beat 0.70, score +0.0011.

(c)/(e) Static allocations x 15 execution rules (22-ETF menu EW with/without EEM+RSP required, 9 sectors EW, SPY/MDY/IJR 80/12/8, SPY/EFA/EEM 60/30/10). The gap depends only on the rule: drift 0; losses-only (tax rule budget 0) 0.000-0.001; budget 0.5% -0.03..-0.06; budget 1% -0.05..-0.10; 1% + 10% harvest -0.02..-0.03 (the only place harvesting has in-engine value: offsetting gains the strategy realizes anyway); budget 5% and tax-blind quarterly -0.05..-0.22 pp/yr. The rule moves results 0.1-0.3 pp/yr; the allocation moves them ~2 pp/yr. Long history: 21-fund long menu tax-blind Q gap -0.29, Fidelity sector proxy -0.32; losses-only 0.00.

(f) Incumbent rule on RANDOM rankings vs momentum (22 ETFs, top 5, Q; screen, 20 seeds). Site TaxManagedCombo 1%: random CA score -0.0022 (sd 0.0021, 15% of seeds positive; ZERO -0.0010); momentum +0.0064 (z = 4.1, above all 20 seeds). Same random picks with the site's standard rule: -0.0296 (gap -0.0233). Full protocol: random + 1% rule (8 seeds) mean -0.0028, all negative; random + standard -0.0303/-0.0287. Pure structure is worth +2.7 pp/yr against tax-blind rotation (gap -2.33 -> -0.12; turnover ~305% -> ~15%/yr) and -0.2..-0.3 pp/yr against SPY. The incumbent's +0.0066 is momentum's pre-tax edge (mapped +0.0077) passed through a nearly tax-free structure (gap -0.0011).

The incumbent with a 0% budget instead of 1% (signal-based, a structure knob; tax_rotation's territory): full CA score +0.0064, full +0.0146, 10/15-yr beat 0.79/0.81, boot_p 0.047, gap -0.0001 (vs -0.0011 at 1%); FED +0.0070, boot_p 0.048. It narrowly fails criterion 2 (15-yr 0.81 < 0.85), as does the 1% incumbent (0.70/0.83). All 7 timing offsets are positive (+0.0047..+0.0079). The cost response is non-monotonic (+0.0070/+0.0038/+0.0051 at 0/15/35 bps). Sub-periods +0.80/-0.47/+0.33 pp/yr.

BEST PURE STRUCTURE: 9 Select Sector SPDRs EW, rebalanced quarterly only through losses (site manual mode, tax-managed, budget 0). Full CA: +0.0023 score, +0.0060 full, 10/15/20-yr beat 0.49/0.55/0.59, boot_p 0.30. With 10% harvesting into twins: +0.0026, boot_p 0.29, but +0.0001 at 35 bps costs. Its gap is 0.0000; it is an equal-weight-sector tilt. Robust to timing (7 offsets +0.0022..+0.0028, all positive), costs (site version) and stricter dividend-tax accounting (unchanged). But: sub-periods CA +3.13/-0.59/-1.75 pp/yr (2000-10/2010-20/2020-26); windows from 2004-10 lose (-0.0038); dropping XLK flips it to -0.0014; iShares and Vanguard sector families lose (-0.0006 / -0.0026); deflated Sharpe 0.009.

HINDSIGHT (30 random 15-25-ETF menus from BROAD_EQUITY_POOL_2003, EW, windows from ~2004). Mean CA score: drift -0.0134, tax-blind Q -0.0180, losses-only -0.0135, 1% budget -0.0162; 0/30 menus positive under any rule. Losses-only beat tax-blind Q on 30/30 menus (+0.0045); vs drift -0.0001. The incumbent menu itself, EW losses-only with windows from 2004: -0.0046.

LONG HISTORY (protocol long 1986-2023, benchmark VFINX). VFINX<->VTSMX harvesting: score +0.0005, holdout 0.0000. Fidelity Select sector proxy of the 9-sector EW losses-only structure (actively managed survivors): CA +0.0149, full +0.0112, 10/15-yr beat 0.75/0.89, boot_p 0.052, ho5 +0.0078, ho10 +0.0060 (beat 0.79). It passes criteria 1-3 in CA and FED, unlike the real SPDR ETFs, so this is conflicting evidence on different instruments. 21-fund long menu EW losses-only: +0.0057, boot_p 0.34, ho10 -0.0059.

DIAGNOSTICS: pure-structure screen grid (216 configs). CA: walk-forward 10/5 OOS -0.0117 (in-sample +0.0095, beat 0.00), 5/3 +0.0018; PBO 0.606; DSR 0.193. NONE: WF -0.0133, PBO 0.936. Full-protocol pure finalists (19), CA: WF -0.0093, PBO 0.779. Choosing the best trailing structure reverses out of sample, as expected when differences are tilt/tracking noise. Criterion 4 fails.

NONE (IRA) check: harvesting never fires without tax lots, so every harvesting config is exactly SPY (excess 0). Tax-aware rebalancing equals tax-blind rebalancing. In ZERO (same decisions, 0% rates) the harvesting configs show only their tracking: e.g. 15% monthly +0.0018 full-protocol score.

hindsight_checks:
PROTOCOL 5.3 checks:
(a) Random menus. 30 menus of 15-25 ETFs drawn from common.BROAD_EQUITY_POOL_2003 (same generator as tax_rotation), held equal weight under 4 rules; every fund required at the window start (~2004+). Mean CA screen score: drift -0.0134, tax-blind quarterly -0.0180, losses-only -0.0135, 1% budget -0.0162. 0/30 menus positive under any rule; 0 pass criteria 1-3. Losses-only beat tax-blind on 30/30 menus (+0.0045). The structure stops leaks; it does not create an edge.
(b) Remove the star, for the best structure (9 sector SPDRs EW, losses-only; base screen CA +0.0027). Dropping XLK flips it to -0.0014. Dropping XLY leaves +0.0005. Dropping the other 7 sectors one at a time gives +0.0020..+0.0056.
(c) Same structure on other index families: iShares IY* (from 2000-07) -0.0006; Vanguard V* (from 2004-10) -0.0026. The SPDRs restricted to the same 2004-10+ windows give -0.0038.
(d) SPY-core harvesting: 6 substitute chains (large-cap only, total market, SPY<->IWB, SPY<->VTI, a mutual-fund chain, mixed). All within -0.0036..+0.0015 with gap 0. Results equal the tracking of whichever substitute is held; buy-and-hold VTI/VV/VTSMX/IWB/IWV alone: +0.0014/+0.0014/+0.0013/+0.0007/-0.0003.
(e) The incumbent's menu (22 ETFs incl. QQQ/XLK) under the pure structure: +0.0010 with 2000 starts, -0.0046 when windows start from 2004 (EEM+RSP required).
(f) Random rankings under the incumbent's rule (20 seeds screen, 8 full): all 8 full-protocol seeds negative (mean -0.0028). Momentum ranks above all 20 screen seeds (z = 4.1).
(g) Long proxies with pre-2000 holdout. VFINX<->VTSMX harvesting: holdout 0.0000. Fidelity Select sector EW: positive holdout (ho10 +0.0060) on active funds. 21-fund long menu: holdout negative (ho10 -0.0059).
concerns: The engine cannot credit tax-loss harvesting. With no $3k ordinary offset, no outside gains, pooled losses and a full terminal liquidation, harvested losses only offset the extra gain their own lower basis creates. Real-world TLH value (deferral against other gains, the $3k offset, step-up/donation) is invisible on the site. It is quantified only as OUTSIDE-ENGINE ARITHMETIC (harvest_value.py). The 'outside gains' scenario is an upper bound: it assumes enough other gains in every loss year, including 2001-02 and 2008, when other holdings were probably losing too.

The best pure structure's edge (9 sector SPDRs EW) is an equal-weight sector tilt that won in 2000-2004-starting windows. It loses from late 2004 (-0.0038), without XLK (-0.0014), and on iShares/Vanguard sector families. Its long-history proxy passes criteria 1-3, but only on actively managed Fidelity Select survivors with narrower sector definitions. Treat the long result as conflicting evidence, not confirmation.

Module flaw, not fixed to preserve the cache: my 'band' rebalancing rule (reb_rule standard + band) skips in-band slots for buys as well as sells. Sale proceeds can sit in cash (avg cash 1-8% for the 10 band configs in group C, versus ~0% elsewhere). Those rows (and their small positive gap) are unreliable; nothing else uses bands.

The mapped/gap decomposition pairs each CA/FED record with its ZERO twin (same rule, 0% rates). For rules whose trades depend on portfolio value (tax-blind bands, budgets, cash cover), the CA and ZERO paths diverge slightly, so gap carries small path noise (largest positive +0.0001 score / +0.0012 full window on a band rule).

Bootstrap p-values depend on the number of resamples. report.table/metrics.summary use 1,000 (used throughout); verify.battery uses 500. Example: the 0%-budget incumbent has boot_p 0.047 (1,000) vs 0.042 (battery). The incumbent's CA boot_p is 0.025 here vs 0.026 in the lead's verify file.

Total-return prices defer dividends for everyone. The realism replay shows this does not change the sector-EW result (+0.60 -> +0.60 pp from 2000), but real accounts also face wash-sale risk from dividend reinvestment and purchases in other accounts. The engine cannot see that; the 31-day guard covers only this account.
FIFO-only lot relief makes harvesting position-level (no specific-lot identification). This understates harvestable losses for multi-lot positions, though in-engine value would stay zero.

The 0%-budget incumbent variant (F_mom_tm0) is signal-based and belongs to the tax_rotation family. Its battery's DSR uses only this family's trial count (470), which understates the multiple-testing penalty of the momentum search.
untested_ideas: Core-satellite in ONE account: an SPY core harvesting into VTI/IWB alongside a momentum satellite that realizes gains. This is the only in-engine channel where harvested losses have value (offsetting gains realized in the same account before the end). tax_rotation's TRStrategy (core + harvest + substitutes) could run it; not tested here.
Harvest-to-rebalance: route harvest proceeds to the most underweight slots instead of the same-exposure twin, i.e. rebalance a static allocation using losses as the only source of cash.
A correct band rebalancer (redistribute proceeds to all underweight slots when any slot breaches its band), to measure the tax gap of band rebalancing cleanly.
Specific-lot (HIFO) harvesting and partial-position harvesting; impossible with the engine's FIFO lots.
Sector replica with point-in-time S&P sector weights (instead of the NNLS fit) and yearly re-fits that add XLRE/XLC through a gain budget, to cut the ~4.4%/yr tracking error after 2016-2018.
Stock-level direct indexing (harvest dispersion is larger for single stocks). Belongs to the stocks family and is biased by survivorship; in-engine value would still be zero without outside gains.
Modelling outside cash flows (contributions/withdrawals): contributions let a taxable investor rebalance and harvest without realizing gains. The engine has no cash flows.
Asset location across a taxable + IRA pair, and gain harvesting in low-bracket years (flat rates in the engine).
lab_bugs: No lab bug found in the lab core. Two limitations worth knowing:

verify.battery silently skips the rebalance-offset and lag checks for registered custom kinds (verify._x_cfg only handles 'weights' and 'combo'). A family with its own kind gets no timing-luck check unless it implements offsets itself; I added an offset_days parameter to tax_structures.slots and ran offsets as group X.

Engine behaviour (site, not lab): the January tax settlement can drive cash negative, effectively an interest-free loan of the tax bill, for strategies that realize gains without selling to raise cash. The site's manual-mode standard combo on the 22-ETF menu reached -$4,533 cash in CA. Small, but it flatters strategies that realize gains and stay fully invested. tax_structures.slots sells to cover (cover_cash=True).

Engine simplification (documented in backtester/tax.py): pooled losses offset short-term gains first. That is more generous than IRS netting when long-term losses meet short-term gains while long-term gains exist. It does not create any positive gap in this family's results.

Site behaviour: manual-mode 'standard' Combo rebalances to equal weight whenever a menu fund first becomes tradable (membership change), so it is not a pure buy-and-hold for menus with late launches (XLRE 2015, XLC 2018, EEM/RSP 2003).
